propositions: Project criteria activated through _project_criteria bypass the probe allowlist filtering that built-in criteria undergo, resulting in extra billable LLM calls during probe mode evaluation
The probe allowlist (E4/G1G2) must be threaded from gate input through the workflow interpreter's with_inputs seam to the batch runner without modifying the generic BatchRunRequest dataclass
_project_criteria must filter activated project criteria to only those present in the probe allowlist, suppressing project criteria outside the allowlist during probe mode
Monkeypatch stubs of _project_criteria in test fixtures must accept a third probe parameter to prevent TypeError when the call site passes the new argument
The caveat paragraph in production_batch_runner.py naming this ticket must be replaced with a description of the implemented probe filtering behaviour
